title: Sector demand, high-ticket goods and cross-channel cultural/attention asymmetry

items.question: Which sector/subsector hypotheses combine unusually high regular eBay buyer demand with genuine discount-producing retailer sources?
items.findings: New source-free research question from the user 2026-10-31; no empirically validated sector winner or buyer attention separation.
items.acceptance: Survey sectors broadly and rank only as hypotheses unless actual eBay transaction and retail offer data exist.
